candidates.title: Heterogeneous SLO Guaranteed Multi-Resource-Aware Batching in LLM Serving
candidates.reason: MuRaはshort/long prompt混在下で異種iteration-time SLO、GPU compute/memory、KV cache早期解放を同時に考慮するbatching。実機traceでthroughput 1.42–11.21倍、goodput 1.43–13.71倍を報告し、LLM serving schedulingに直接該当。

candidates.title: ReliefServe: Relieving GPU Pressure in Multi-Model Serving via Selective CPU Escape
candidates.reason: GPU過負荷時にCPU-tolerant modelを選択的にCPUへescapeさせ、profiling・pressure control・CPU cache preparationを統合する。12-server実験で平均latency最大27.05%削減、goodput 39.74%改善し、CPU/GPU階層推論に直接関連。

candidates.title: FaultSense: Fault Localization in Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts Model Serving Infrastructure
candidates.reason: 数百GPU規模MoE servingでall-to-all通信のgray failureをapplication layerから局所化する。軽量MoE probeと二段階hierarchical localizationで診断試験数を最大20倍削減し、大規模MoE基盤の信頼性研究として有用。

candidates.title: SSQT: A Hardware-Friendly Fusion Compression Framework of Structured Sparsification and Sensitivity-Driven Quantization for Large-Scale Language Models
candidates.reason: structured sparsification・sensitivity-driven outlier preservation・低bit group quantizationを実行layoutと共同設計。Llama2-13BでFP16比24.3% memory、A100 TPでdecode最大2.33倍を報告し、圧縮を実推論高速化へ結びつける。

candidates.title: GACER-M: Granularity-Aware and Memory-Centric Coordination for Multi-Tenant Deep Learning
candidates.reason: Generative AIを含むmulti-tenant GPUでoperator splittingとmemory-driven temporal coordinationを統合し、OOM安全性を保ちながらcompute-boundで1.35–1.67倍、memory-criticalでaggregate throughput 1.4倍を報告。serving資源管理の隣接重要研究。
